final_dossier_model.title: Cross-domain final-dossier composition and authoritative-source model
final_dossier_model.statement: The consolidated set of required final dossiers and their authoritative sources, coverage requirements, known limitations, decision authorities, and gate destinations, with generated summaries remaining non-authoritative projections.

final_dossier_requirements.title: Consolidated final-dossier requirement
final_dossier_requirements.statement: The requirement that each required final dossier name its authoritative contents, evidence sources, coverage, limitations, decision authority, and gate destination, with generated summaries remaining non-authoritative projections.
final_dossier_requirements.prohibited_inference: Dossier defined is not dossier populated is not acceptance granted.
